{{- define "doc-footer" -}}
{{- if or .EditURL (not .Page.Updated.IsZero) }}
{{- with .EditURL }} {{ template "icon" "edit" }}{{ t "edit_page" }} {{- end }} {{- if not .Page.Updated.IsZero }} {{ t "last_updated" }} {{ formatDateWith .Page.Updated "%B %d, %Y" }} {{- end }}
{{- end }} {{- $root := default (dig .Theme.Extra "docs_root") "" -}} {{- with .Index.Neighbors $root .CurrentURL }} {{- if or .Prev .Next }}
{{- with .Prev }} {{ template "icon" "arrow-left" }}{{ t "previous" }} {{ .Title }} {{- end }} {{- with .Next }} {{ t "next" }}{{ template "icon" "arrow-right" }} {{ .Title }} {{- end }}
{{- end }} {{- end }}
{{- end -}}
